settingsCreateAccount2.faq2Answer.en:
If you want to access your notes from multiple devices or you wish to share notes with other users, then yes.

If you want to keep your notes only on this device and not sync them anywhere, then no.
settingsCreateAccount2.faq2Answer.da:
Hvis du vil have adgang til dine noter fra flere enheder, eller hvis du ønsker at dele noter med andre brugere, så ja.

Hvis du kun vil beholde dine noter på denne enhed og ikke synkronisere dem nogen steder, så nej.

If you want access to your notes from several devices, or if you wish to share notes with other users, then yes.

If you only want to keep your notes on this device and not synchronize them anywhere, then no.

settingsCreateAccount2.faq3Question._note: 'data' is grammatically plural in Danish, hence 'er'/'sikre'.

settingsCreateAccount2.faq4Answer.en:
No, unfortunately we cannot help you recover your password.

Making this possible would substantially weaken your data security.
settingsCreateAccount2.faq4Answer.da:

No, unfortunately we cannot help you to recover your password.

Making it possible would weaken your data security considerably.

settingsCreateAccount2.faq5Answer.en:
Technically a Local Account offers stronger privacy guarantees. However, with a well-chosen password the difference is academic.

And a Local Account does not help ensure your own access to the data in case of device loss or in an emergency situation.

Ultimately it depends on what you are trying to achieve.
settingsCreateAccount2.faq5Answer.da:
Teknisk set giver en lokal konto stærkere privatlivsgarantier. Med en velvalgt adgangskode er forskellen dog akademisk.

Og en lokal konto sikrer ikke din egen adgang til dataene i tilfælde af tab af enheden eller en nødsituation.

I sidste ende afhænger det af, hvad du forsøger at opnå.
settingsCreateAccount2.faq5Answer.da_en:
Technically a local account gives stronger privacy guarantees. With a well-chosen password the difference is however academic.

And a local account does not ensure your own access to the data in case of loss of the device or in an emergency situation.

Ultimately it depends on what you are trying to achieve.

subCustomerData.whyAsk.en: Why do we ask for this information?
subCustomerData.whyAsk.da: Hvorfor spørger vi om disse oplysninger?
subCustomerData.whyAsk.da_en: Why do we ask about this information?

subCustomerData.whyAskInfo.en:
We need your country of residence to manage VAT (this has no impact on the price you pay - the price you are shown is the final price).

We will use your email address solely to send you receipts, notifications of failed payments, and reminders prior to renewal. Your email address also serves as a last resort for canceling your subscription in case you lose access to your account.

We will never use your email address for marketing purposes, newsletters, or any other kind of unsolicited communication.

The above data is shared with our payment provider to process your payment, primarily for fraud prevention.

We will, however, never share your data with any other parties. See our Privacy Policy for details.

All data is handled in compliance with both GDPR and Swiss data protection laws, regardless of your country of residence.
subCustomerData.whyAskInfo.da:
Vi har brug for dit bopælsland for at håndtere moms (dette har ingen indflydelse på den pris, du betaler – den viste pris er den endelige pris).

Vi vil udelukkende bruge din e-mailadresse til at sende dig kvitteringer, notifikationer om mislykkede betalinger og påmindelser før fornyelse. Din e-mailadresse fungerer også som sidste udvej til at opsige dit abonnement, hvis du mister adgangen til din konto.

Vi vil aldrig bruge din e-mailadresse til markedsføring, nyhedsbreve eller anden form for uopfordret kommunikation.

Ovennævnte data deles med vores betalingsudbyder for at behandle din betaling, primært med henblik på svindelforebyggelse.

Vi vil dog aldrig dele dine data med andre parter. Se vores privatlivspolitik for detaljer.

Alle data håndteres i overensstemmelse med både GDPR og schweizisk databeskyttelseslovgivning, uanset dit bopælsland.
subCustomerData.whyAskInfo.da_en:
We need your country of residence to handle VAT (this has no influence on the price you pay – the displayed price is the final price).

We will use your email address solely to send you receipts, notifications about failed payments and reminders before renewal. Your email address also functions as a last resort to cancel your subscription, if you lose access to your account.

We will never use your email address for marketing, newsletters or any other form of unsolicited communication.

The above-mentioned data is shared with our payment provider in order to process your payment, primarily for the purpose of fraud prevention.

We will however never share your data with other parties. See our privacy policy for details.

All data is handled in accordance with both GDPR and Swiss data protection legislation, regardless of your country of residence.
subCustomerData.whyAskInfo._note:
All
tags, markup, and URL preserved exactly. En-dash used per Danish typography. GDPR preserved as acronym. Idiomatic Danish throughout.
